name: WF-01 - Lead Magnet Intake and Scoring

nodes.name: GS - Read Config
nodes.notes: Reads the key/value/description rows from the Config tab (BOOKING_URL, OWNER_EMAIL, A_GRADE_MIN, B_GRADE_MIN, FOLLOWUP_1_DAYS, LOOM_SLA_HOURS, SYSTEM_VERSION, etc). This node has no outgoing connection on purpose - it is referenced by name via $('GS - Read Config') from CODE - Calculate Scores so thresholds are never hard-coded in more than one place (spec section 4.2).

nodes.name: GS - Append Activity Log (Invalid Email)
nodes.notes: T07: invalid email format must be marked invalid and logged, not scored as a normal lead.

nodes.name: GS - Lookup Suppression List
nodes.notes: Filters on work_email (matches the real Suppression_List schema: work_email, reason, added_at_utc, source_lead_id, notes). alwaysOutputData is required so a zero-match (normal, non-suppressed) result still emits one empty item instead of silently killing the branch.

nodes.name: IF - Is Suppressed?
nodes.notes: True = a matching row came back from Suppression_List (spec 8.1 node 5: stop if unsubscribed, blocked or previous hard bounce).

nodes.name: GS - Lookup Existing Lead
nodes.notes: Matches by normalized email. Filter reads the original validated email directly by node reference (not $json) because the previous node in this chain may have returned zero rows and $json would then be empty.

nodes.name: GS - Lookup Existing Lead by Domain
nodes.notes: Spec 8.1 node 6: match by email first, then company domain. Per T05 this must never blind-merge a different email at the same domain - CODE - Build Lead Record only uses this to set possible_duplicate_account for manual review.

value.details: ={{JSON.stringify({ grade: $json.lead_grade, qualification_score: $json.qualification_score, system_health_score: $json.system_health_score, recommended_offer: $json.recommended_offer, estimated_value: $json.estimated_value, possible_duplicate_account: $json.possible_duplicate_account, related_lead_id: $json.related_lead_id, utm_source: $json.utm_source, utm_medium: $json.utm_medium, utm_campaign: $json.utm_campaign, utm_content: $json.utm_content, referrer_url: $json.referrer_url, landing_page_url: $json.landing_page_url, form_version: $json.form_version, submission_timestamp: $json.submission_timestamp, device_type: $json.device_type, browser: $json.browser })}}

nodes.name: GS - Append Activity Log
nodes.notes: The real Leads tab has no columns for possible_duplicate_account/related_lead_id or the raw UTM/device/browser fields, so they are preserved here in details instead of being silently dropped by autoMapInputData.

nodes.name: EXEC - Result Delivery (A)
nodes.notes: Point this at WF-02 Result Email Delivery. Same node type reused for B and C branches below.
